entries.text: Vantrilex Arsenal is an OpenCode plugin plus a component Registry that provisions a curated kit of agent components onto a target project and governs how that kit is used; the repo holds Markdown, JSON, and Node ESM with a Node-only toolchain, and it contains no AI or ML model logic.

You equip a project through the Vanguard run: it surveys sources, presents a shortlist for your approval, installs with real commands only, verifies every component with its per-kind protocol, and writes the documentation set; any component it cannot verify keeps a null command with verification unverified.

The catalog Markdown stays the source of truth and registry/catalog.json is its regenerated derived mirror that you never hand-edit, while kit/kit.lock is the pinned record of what a project actually received at 157 components (32 tier core plus 125 tier conditional) with a pending list of 9 theme entries; pending means approved but not yet provisioned.

You prove a change with node scripts/verify-registry.mjs, the catalog mirror regeneration check, node scripts/verify-kit.mjs, shellcheck-clean shell scripts, tsc --noEmit-clean plugin TypeScript, and resolvable relative docs links; a check you cannot evaluate is a failed check.

entries.section: The six hooks that did not migrate
entries.text: On OpenCode V2 only the task-dispatcher hook fires; the other six hooks and the docs-discipline guard remain V1-only and inert by deliberate unfinished gap, while the machine runs unified on V2 with the plugin proven on the V2 surface.

You name exactly one scenario per turn: a new task dispatches from scratch, an unchanged continuation stays silent and changes nothing, a modification re-dispatches and states what changed, a continuation with modification re-plans only what has not run, and a new task alongside open work checkpoints and parks the open task in its own lane.
